A. CONNECTED PROSE -- complete sentences that follow from one another, where the
   relationships between the points are spelled out in words.
B. A LIST -- separate items stated one after another, with no wording that
   relates them to each other, whether or not the items are full sentences.

-------

Format requires official template or three years documented revision history.
Tier-1 venue presentation allowed only if more than 18 months before deadline.
Exactly 18 months fails R3.
Prior round acceptance blocks handling fewer than 5 years elapsed since round.
Exactly 5 years elapsed fine for prior rounds.
Paired submissions limited to exactly 2 manuscripts.
Three or more not permitted form.
Both paired manuscripts need R1 and R2 compliance independently satisfied.
At least one paired manuscript satisfies R3 requirement.
Track D exempt from R2 only needs exactly 2 endorsements.
One endorsement insufficient for Track D submission.
Open retraction notice prevents handling regardless other rules including R9.

Figure count 8 to 45 inclusive.
Paired submission max figures 70 minimum 8.
Fewer than minimum figures triggers PADDED verdict padded up rather returned outright.
More than applicable maximum figures returns outright submission.
Submission fails R9 only gets PADDED verdict assigned.
Submission fails another rule also returns RETURNED regardless figure status.
R7 overrides all rules including R9 exceptions.
R6 exemption applies manuscript from R2 only not other rules.
Deadline 1 March 2026 every rule evaluated as of that date.

Answer with exactly one letter: either "A" or "B".","role":"user"}],"model":"gpt-oss:120b","options":{"seed":738377849,"temperature":0.7},"stream":false,"think":"medium"}
